question: Does the teacher-fitted bilateral c_proj endpoint repair improve complete language-model CE, or is the high held-out MLP-output recovery pointed in a task-irrelevant direction?
scientific_scope: teacher-guided endpoint oracle; no language-model training update and not a deployable teacher-free method

chart.implementation: exact production cached bilateral c_proj chart

fit_protocol.objective: per-layer MSE between charted plain-cproj MLP output and frozen attention-only MLP output

variants: each fitted layer alone with every other chart at identity

decision_rule.positive_task_direction: all-layer rollout improves holdout CE by at least 0.005, or a layer selected by fit CE independently improves holdout CE by at least 0.005
decision_rule.noncompositional_teacher_target: one or more fit-selected single layers improve holdout CE, but all-layer rollout does not
decision_rule.reject_teacher_repair_direction: neither all-layer rollout nor any fit-selected single layer improves holdout CE by 0.005
decision_rule.causal_training_policy: do not launch another 238-step training screen unless the endpoint oracle establishes a positive complete-model CE direction

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable because this diagnostic performs no language-model training update
required_artifacts: summary JSON with code commit, command, source hashes, checkpoint hashes, dataset identity, and artifact hashes
